usedFor: SandeshChat carries the conversations, and Microsoft Excel logs each “New Inbound Message Arrives” through “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Inbound Message Arrives” in SandeshChat, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each inbound message becomes a row, giving support a sortable log of what customers wrote.

watchOut: “Message Delivery Status Changes” fires per message, so pair it with “Update Row” rather than adding duplicate rows.
